title: Final Answer On Axis
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct diameter of the Airy disk for a star on axis using the given formula.

title: Correct Formula Usage
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the formula d = 1.22 * lambda * f / D in their calculations.

title: Parameter Values
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify and use the values for D, f, and lambda in their calculations.

title: Off Axis Discussion
description: Important Criteria: The student should discuss the effect of off-axis positioning on resolution and the change in effective aperture.

title: Image Blob Size
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide additional context or checks regarding the size of the image blob for visible light.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations to avoid errors.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes when discussing the effects of angles on resolution.
